name: c2_take4
prompt: One continuous cinematic architectural take inside this exact dark wood-panelled bedroom, slow and stabilized. The camera arcs gently to the left through the open floor space beside the bed and rotates until the black cylindrical wood stove standing on the stone floor beside the tall black-framed forest windows is framed in a flattering three-quarter view, with the windows and part of the bedroom still in shot. The stove's firebox is cold and completely dark when it first comes into view. After the stove is clearly framed, a single small flame flickers to life on the logs behind its closed glass door and grows slowly into a warm steady wood fire, amber light building on the black stove body and the stone floor. The flames stay entirely inside the stove. The camera settles and drifts very gently at the end. Level horizon, natural parallax, gentle ease-in and ease-out. The real room never changes: dark vertical wall panels, round black mirror above the bed, dark grey bedding with white pillows and a round brass tray, grey stone tiled floor, brass pendant tubes, the same stove shape, glass door and flue pipe, the same windows and forest. Daylight stays constant. The ceiling-mounted television stays folded flat against the ceiling. No smoke in the room, no sparks, no fire outside the stove, no people, no text.
